items.title: PayPal (PYPL) Stock Looks Reasonable Based On Current Earnings
items.summary: PayPal Holdings has seen its share price fall sharply over the past few years, even as new partnerships put the company back in the headlines. With the stock around US$53.89, the question for investors is whether that price is adequately backed by the earnings the business is generating today. PayPal shares have declined 79.4% over the past 5 years, which puts the focus squarely on whether the current earnings profile supports where the stock now trades. items.title: Why Is PayPal Holdings (PYPL) Tightening Fraud Controls Across Its Payments Network?
items.summary: PayPal Holdings (NasdaqGS: PYPL) is now integrated with IPQualityScore within platforms such as Alloy, Shopify, and Stripe. The IPQS connection feeds fraud intelligence and digital risk signals directly into PayPal transaction and account workflows for participating merchants. The expanded integration is expected to affect customer onboarding checks, security event handling, and fraud detection rules used across the PayPal ecosystem. items.title: What Has The Market Missed In Coinbase Stock's Drop?
items.summary: Coinbase Global (COIN) has been moving its business away from bitcoin trading and into other products. You probably still think of Coinbase as a bet on the price of bitcoin. The stock has lost 38% over the past year, while the S&P 500 returned 17.7%. A fall that deep looks like what you would expect from a company tied to bitcoin trading. So how much of Coinbase's business still comes from bitcoin trading.
